Must visit: Excellent food with local home-grown products
Aug 2026 • Family
When we arrived at the restaurant, it was empty and we were quite worried. After dinning in Kumquat BBQ, we didn't understand why: we were 4 days in Hoi An and it was the BEST restaurant where we have been. Mr Victor cooked in front of us a delicious food with home-grown local products (especial mention to the vegetables -and we are not very fond of vegetables in general :) -) and he was really gentle and kind to us.
I definitely recommend it if you are at least one night in Hoi An, especially if you want to avoid the crowds of the old quarter.
I'd definitely come back!
